notes.title: Coming soon BIG UPDATE [3.0]
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone[/h1]

I've been gone for quite a while, but I can't wait to release a huge update (we're reworking the entire game).

[b]We?[/b] Yes, now it’s not only me working on the game, but also an amazing master of his craft, who has already taught me a lot. I will introduce him in an upcoming update, but for now, he will be shrouded in geometric mysticism.

We are completely reworking the items, as at the moment, the huge potential for replayability is not that huge and lies in the initial selection and number of items. Our idea is that items should also be composite. I already see huge potential and unexpected builds that break the game, and I like it.

We don't know how long it will take to complete the update, but it will be worth it (trust me).

But items are not the only thing that will be updated. Thanks to the new team member, the game will now have:

[list]
[*] A large number of localizations
[*] The ability to save AT ANY MOMENT OF THE GAME (without exploits to break the game)
[*] New content updates will be available even in a saved run
[*] Updated character selection
[*] Optimization
[/list]

These 5 points have been fully realized thanks to the new team member, and I am very happy to work with him. Everyone will love the results of his fantastic work.

notes.title: UPDATE [2.5] - New Hand Laser Ability and new Bonus System
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone[/h1]

New Ability "Homing Laser System" available for use.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44828226/00d52b7864e9a1e6303545e886a44e8a4b613847.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44828226/378338c10e8e4f38c786f4a2fa98e2882b15cd98.gif[/img]

The Homing Laser System aims at the nearest enemy.
Base damage equals the [i]weapon's damage[/i], with the divisor being the gun port.
Each subsequent use extends the duration by half the [i]ability's lifetime[/i] and [i]5s[/i] of bonus time.
The time between each attack is the [i]Attack cooldown[/i], which adds up to unique combinations with each weapon, and now with the character, since the new [b]Bonus system[/b] is also available in the game now

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44828226/11cfe44016b6a60760749eb7b1955f0e67bb618b.png[/img]

Experimental: 
[list]
[*] Every element of load out now gives you a little (or big) bonus This includes Weapons, Abilities, and Characters.
[*] Ballistic target bullets can no longer spin, giving greater projection on bounces.
[/list]

UPDATES:
[list]
[*] Elite Item Adeptus Lustratus now Add +1 LVL of homing, instead of 1 LVL. It means if you already have 1LVL you gain 2LVL.
[*] Bolt of chaos and Elite Item "Little Help" (Laser) now available to Icosphere character.
[*] The boss's trigger line has been moved into view when spawning into the arena.
[*] Explosive enemies now have landmarks on each edge, distinguishing them at minimum health from normal enemies.
[*] x2 Abilitie penalty for each subsequent use has been increased from 40% and per each extra use add 0.01%.
[*] After reaching 50% you get nothing, if the penalty is > 50% you starting to lose your bonuses, but it is still 0.01% per usage, so you can pretty long stay in this condition if your build allows it.
[*] Tentacle character exp Mod reduced from 0.2 to 0.1.
[*] Tentacle character gains exp boost only 30 sec, besides 90.
[*] Description update. Some colored aspects~
[*] Load Out UI change.
[/list]

Ability "DESTROY" rebalance:
[list]
[*] Mana Price redused from 3 to 2.
[*] Lifetime increased from 15s to 20s.
[*] Charge speed reduced from 10s to 5s.
[/list]

BUGFIX:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where Boss Pyramid stopped spawning as a minion after the first time.
[*] BUGFIX: Fixed a bug where when pressing quickly the treatment did not occur.
[*] Fixed a bug where if mana was restored and the restoration of a mana cell was purchased in the Boss Arena, then after Ability use the basic mana restoration was not triggered.
[/list]
BUGS:
[list]
[*] Sound Cracking 30
[*] Inverse cinematics of the cutted tentacles of Torus include collisions with the character and also behave unpredictably
[/list]
